finalText:
The build passes now, 0 errors.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — `maxRetries: retries` referenced a variable named `retries` that never existed, instead of pulling it from `env.retries`. That crashed the link stage every time, underneath all the noise from the compile warnings.

I changed it to `maxRetries: env.retries || 3`, matching the fallback pattern already used for `cacheSize` right above it.

`node build.js` now finishes clean: 3 warnings, 0 errors, exit code 0.
